name: The River at Rancho Mirage
description: The River at Rancho Mirage is an upscale open-air lifestyle center featuring a carefully curated mix of restaurants, retail stores, a movie theater, and kiosk vendors in the heart of the Coachella Valley. The center offers a vibrant outdoor experience with regular events including live entertainment, Battle of the Bands, and seasonal celebrations, creating a dynamic gathering place for the community. With its blend of dining, shopping, and entertainment options, The River provides a premier destination for both residents and visitors to Rancho Mirage.
demographics: The River at Rancho Mirage attracts an affluent, mature demographic with visitors predominantly aged 45-65+ representing retirees and seasonal residents from the greater Palm Springs area. The trade area serves high-income households with annual incomes exceeding $100,000, many of whom are empty nesters and luxury resort visitors seeking upscale dining and entertainment experiences. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for experiential retail with extended evening visits centered around restaurants, the movie theater, and special events rather than traditional retail shopping.
summary: The River at Rancho Mirage is an upscale open-air lifestyle destination combining dining, entertainment, and retail in the heart of California's Coachella Valley.
